program:
alphabet marker a b

is_bos = bos
is_marker = symbol marker
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@j, !is_b@i & !is_marker@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_bos@i & is_marker@i & is_a@i & is_b@i & is_bos@j & is_marker@j & is_a@j & is_b@j, is_bos@i & !is_marker@i & is_a@i & is_b@i & is_bos@j & is_marker@j & is_a@j & is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !h1_2@j, !h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & is_marker@j & !h1_2@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(!h1_2@i & !is_bos@j & is_marker@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & !h1_2@j, !is_a@j & !h1_2@j)
accept = !is_bos & !h1_1 & h2_1 & h2_2

output accept
